Due to a persistent geological obstruction, there is no viable direct route connecting Station Alpha and Station Beta. Furthermore, due to seasonal access restrictions, the inspection circuit must incorporate exactly one of two critical mountain passes: either the route between Station Beta and Station Gamma, or the route between Station Gamma and Station Delta.

The objective is to determine the shortest possible closed-loop inspection tour that visits each station precisely once before returning to the origin, while adhering to the mandatory routing constraints.
